summary: Frontend-only verification of Hub/Dashboard CircleNav redesign. Registered fresh parent + professional accounts. All requested flows verified end-to-end: /hub thin page + circle-nav (uniform + safety + 8 bubbles) renders correctly; Dashboard now shows circle-nav-section as main action area with existing tools grid intact; uniform circle -> /joint/new?subjects=all-7; each bubble (school confirmed, all 8 present) -> /joint/new?subject=<key> (wizard loads with joint-new-page, joint-steps, joint-child-input etc.); bubble-__complete -> /hub/complete; parent safety circle -> /dashboard?contact=professional AND auto-opens the pro form (pro-contact-form and pro-select visible without clicking contact-professional-btn); pro subtext differs from parent subtext (contains 'professional-facilitated'); pro safety circle -> /joint/new?subject=safety; mobile viewport 390x844 shows circle-nav-mobile (grid) with circle-uniform-mobile/circle-safety-mobile/bubble-mobile-*. Old testids (hub-main-cluster, hub-topic-*, hub-safety-circle, hub-create-btn) confirmed removed.

issues: Minor React hydration warning in dev tools instrumentation: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' comes from ve-tagger wrapping option children in a <span> — cosmetic dev-only warning, not from user code; does not break functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: CircleNav.jsx uses color.replace('text-','bg-') on the color className string to derive divider color — works for current 'text-brand-*' values but is fragile if color prop changes shape.
The dev-only ve-tagger warning about <span> inside <option> is not from CircleNav but from Dashboard's professionals <select><option> list; safe to ignore in production build.
